name: Hamburg

queries.query: Hamburg ALKIS Flurstücke WFS Geoportal Grundstücke Flurstück Hamburg official
queries.result: Hamburg’s official open-data catalog exposes the LGV INSPIRE Flurstücke WFS, described as ALKIS parcel boundaries, parcel numbers and cadastral districts. Root confirmed native geometry contains circular arcs.
queries.executionMethod: Official metadata and city-service pages plus anonymous direct WFS capabilities, schema, count-only probes, and bounded feature request.

queries.query: Hamburg official cadastral parcel dataset ALKIS WFS cadastral parcels open data
queries.result: Official Hamburg metadata identifies the dataset operator LGV, Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 licensing and WFS/WMS/GML access; anonymous WFS capabilities list INSPIRE CadastralParcel.
queries.executionMethod: English-language search followed by source page and direct endpoint inspection.

requests.observation: Anonymous WFS 2.0 capabilities list cp:CadastralParcel and cp:CadastralZoning; no access constraints.
Feature schema includes nationalCadastralReference, label, areaValue, identifier and geometry. Full feature returned its safe parcel identifier fields.

CRS:84 bbox near WUP, COUNT=3 returned three distinct full cp:CadastralParcel members; root numberMatched=unknown and numberReturned=0 contradict actual payload. CRS EPSG:25832. One sample native reference 020302___02581______ contains WUP center.

Thirteen adjacent small-cell RESULTTYPE=hits GETs all returned count-only responses; numberMatched values [3,2,5,6,6,4,3,3,4,4,4,4,4], numberReturned=0 and zero members in each. Counts are overlapping and local only.

Forced startIndex=3,count=1 for the WUP bbox returned zero members; count-only hit count for bbox was 3. Header again reported numberMatched=unknown and numberReturned=0; cannot qualify reliable pagination.
Same bounded GetFeature query with outputFormat=application/json rejected: not configured to handle application/json; repository GeoJSON WFS adapter cannot consume this WFS.

portals.name: Hamburg ALKIS INSPIRE Flurstücke dataset
portals.operator: Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV), Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg
portals.observation: Official dataset metadata says cadastral parcel boundaries, parcel numbers and cadastral districts from ALKIS; dataset offers public WFS/WMS/GML, Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: 67 valid, distinct ALKIS cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local cells around the WUP Hamburg settlement locator. Provider-generated GeoJSON preserves the original curved boundaries; exact geographic Intersects filters avoid native projected-envelope false positives. Stable counts before and after pages, fresh native cadastral-reference reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry or overlaps above 0.01 m² in the sample. Citywide completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term ID permanence remain unverified.

Count header zero is a documented unknown sentinel in the response comment; independent count/paging still require qualification.
